notes: Simulation: the referenced game's layout is a row of equally spaced per-player plots you fill with collected characters, and the loop here is collect eggs, hatch them onto your plot, and steal from neighbours — a collection and income loop, not roleplay or an exploration hunt, so I did not name Roleplay or Adventure. plot-isolated is the per-player-plot shape and the answer's eight plots keeps the map small; I kept Sandbox rather than Tycoon because the plots are per-player rather than one shared plot, and its collectible-nodes covers the eggs while social-hub covers the shared central area. I added path-circulation, which the preset lacks, because stealing only works if a walkable street connects the plots to each other and to the hub. Deciding without a user: the plots are open-front display stands rather than enterable buildings, so no P3, and stealing itself is gameplay that the layout only has to support through adjacency and open access.
